notes:
Dahu 0.101.4 beta for Windows

- Consistent command confirmation: Enter/Space accepts the current step; editing a numeric option returns to the command before a second confirmation executes it.
- Clear Confirm, Back/Esc and Cancel/Esc controls across command options, with existing previews and Undo preserved.
- Absolute World pointer coordinates in a fixed-width bottom-right area, using the document units and snap-aware updates.
- Full-width command history and stable viewport dimensions while changing tools.

Windows installer includes a signed automatic-update package. The executable is not Authenticode-signed; Windows may show a publisher warning on first installation.
